reviews.name: Nina F
reviews.text: Andrea was incredible. She helped me tremendously throughout my entire transfer application process, from strategizing my school list to refining my personal essay until it really captured my voice. Her guidance made a stressful process feel manageable, and I genuinely don't think I would have gotten the results I did without her support. My younger brother, who's now starting his own college application process, will be working with her too.

reviews.name: John Raidt
reviews.text: My son is now a rising senior at Duke University and he is thriving there. After working closely with Andrea on essay preparation, application completion and interviewing skills, he had a seamless transition into the university of his dreams. Top universities such as Duke take less than 5% of applicants. With Andrea's help, our son became part of that percentile.

reviews.name: Albert Peng
reviews.text: Andrea was extremely helpful with suggesting topics to write about, proofreading all of my essays and guiding me on polishing them until they were perfect. She was very friendly and patient, and gave good feedback for every draft. With her help I got into multiple top colleges, including Carnegie Mellon and the UCs.

reviews.name: Felicity Fu
reviews.text: Andrea is one of the strongest educators and advisors I have worked with. She brings a rare combination of sharp writing judgment, deep educational insight, and genuine care for students. Her support goes far beyond correcting essays. The students we have supported have achieved outstanding admissions results, including acceptances to top 20 universities.

reviews.name: Manar Lezaar
reviews.text: From the very beginning, they took the time to really understand my background, goals, and what made my story unique. I never felt like they were trying to change my voice, just strengthen it. They also gave very honest feedback, which I appreciated a lot. If something wasn't working, they would tell me clearly and then help me fix it.

reviews.name: Mythili P
reviews.text: Andrea helped me immensely with my graduate school personal statement. Her guidance helped me express my ideas with greater clarity and authenticity, and I truly could not have accomplished this without her support.

reviews.name: Sophia Schiralli
reviews.text: As a peer in the same industry, I can personally say Andrea's editing is the most refined I have seen. Her rapport and individualized feedback with students on their essays and the college application process has led to many admissions into top schools.

reviews.name: David Palumbo
reviews.text: She is an exceptional writer whose clarity, precision, and creativity elevate every assignment. Her ability to communicate complex ideas, meet deadlines, and contribute thoughtful feedback has made her one of the most reliable advisors I've worked with. 10/10.

reviews.name: Justin Kramer
reviews.text: Andrea helped me make a professional résumé, and gave me the confidence to apply to jobs because I know it's perfect.
